# @metator/testing

<!-- metator:generated:start -->

## Responsibility

Fakes of the ports that tests need in memory, contract suites for the ports that have one (file system and lock, process runner, version control, rule engine, worktrees, machine state, tree copier, data isolator, the hosts and their generators, code and review hosts, contract differ), shared fixtures (the Bun-workspaces monorepo) and a throwaway real Postgres (`startPostgres`, `postgresScript`) used by unit and e2e tests.

## Invariants

- An adapter of a port that has a contract suite runs it; a fake of such a port runs it too (MT-TEST-002), except a double that only replays scripted answers [[cite: packages/testing/src/contracts/file-system.contract.ts:10 | "export function fileSystemContract(name: string, make: FileSystemFactory): void {"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` only. Production code never imports it.

## Pitfalls

- A fake that is more lenient than the real adapter hides bugs; when an adapter test finds a difference, fix the fake too.
